purpose.summary: Establish an attributed, locked and CI-enforced public Chronik port core for ALP/SLP parsing and verification, database logic and protobuf generation, while repairing the baseline's Boost 1.90 filesystem API compatibility and keeping every node runtime bridge dormant.
scope: Bind 206 exact regular files and three declared comment-whitespace adaptations to public Bitcoin ABC donor commit 784d83de2e19eab726898d77bfe7465410d27a9c and preserve its MIT notices.
Restore the donor ALP and SLP parser, coloring and verification tests, and execute bitcoinsuite-core, bitcoinsuite-slp, chronik-db and chronik-proto from a reduced locked Cargo workspace.
Import bridge, indexer, HTTP and library sources as exact attributed donor bytes but exclude them from the executable workspace until the separately reviewed runtime-adaptation lot.
Add a default-off CMake target, exact Rust 1.85 CI job, static donor manifest and fail-closed provenance validator.
Extend the general publication gate so every engineering change record is schema-checked and exercised by rejection self-tests.
Replace three removed Boost.Filesystem APIs with their current equivalents and compile both wallet and node production paths under Boost 1.90.0.
exclusions: No node event bridge, runtime service, HTTP or gRPC API is enabled or linked by this lot.
No consensus, mempool, activation, chain-selection, wallet semantics, P2P, network identity or mainnet parameter changes.
No private history, private source, operator data, incoming report, binary, build output or host-specific path is tracked.

commands: Configure a fresh supported Linux build with BUILD_CHRONIK_BUILD_ONLY=OFF, BUILD_CHRONIK_PORT_CORE=OFF and BUILD_CHRONIK_OBSERVER=OFF; require no Cargo or chronik edge before building bitcoind.
expected_results: The standalone node build graph and binary remain independent of Rust and Chronik.

commands: Configure a separate fresh build with BUILD_CHRONIK_PORT_CORE=ON and the runtime observer disabled; fetch the exact lock once, then build and test the four default members offline under Rust 1.85.0.

Configure a no-Git macOS arm64 materialization with Boost 1.90.0, Berkeley DB 5.3.28, wallet enabled, Qt/ZMQ/UPnP disabled, BUILD_CHRONIK_PORT_CORE=ON and BUILD_CHRONIK_OBSERVER=OFF; build wallet and bitcoind, then run bitcoind --version.
expected_results: All core, ALP/SLP, database, protobuf and documentation tests pass; no runtime observer option is registered or executed.
The wallet library and wallet-enabled bitcoind compile and link, and the daemon reports Bitcoin Static v24.0.5 without loading a datadir.

commands: Preserve the existing separately governed local-regtest observer profile and rerun its bounded optional-indexing matrix after the port-core corpus succeeds.
expected_results: The existing observe/index-only matrix remains behaviorally unchanged; this lot adds no runtime route to the imported bridge or service crates.

scenarios.command: Run the existing local-regtest opt-in observer scenario from a fresh datadir.
expected_results: Observer opt-in remains explicit and node authority remains unchanged.
failure_conditions: Implicit enablement, node-authority effect, skip, timeout or nonzero exit.

scenarios.command: Run the existing bounded 288-block restart reconstruction scenario.
expected_results: The retained projection reconstructs identically after restart.
failure_conditions: Projection divergence, incomplete cleanup, skip, timeout or nonzero exit.

scenarios.command: Run the existing bounded full-reindex reconstruction scenario.
expected_results: Full reindex reconstructs the retained projection.
failure_conditions: Projection divergence, incomplete cleanup, skip, timeout or nonzero exit.

scenarios.command: Run the existing bounded chainstate-reindex reconstruction scenario.
expected_results: Chainstate reindex reconstructs the retained projection.
failure_conditions: Projection divergence, incomplete cleanup, skip, timeout or nonzero exit.

scenarios.command: Run the existing bounded pruned-datadir reconstruction scenario.
expected_results: The available active-chain suffix reconstructs within the governed bound.
failure_conditions: Out-of-bound access, projection divergence, skip, timeout or nonzero exit.

scenarios.command: Run the existing deep-reorg contradiction scenario below the retained anchor.
expected_results: The observer marks rebuild-required and rejects further updates until reconstruction.
failure_conditions: Silent continuation, node-authority effect, skip, timeout or nonzero exit.

limitations: This lot makes the token, database and protobuf corpus buildable and tested; it does not yet connect accepted node events to Chronik or expose a query API.

Imported chronik-bridge, chronik-indexer, chronik-http and chronik-lib sources are donor-bound and deliberately excluded and uncompiled until the next adaptation lot; one dormant HTTP manifest has a declared comment-whitespace-only adaptation.
The local Rust 1.85 run is a component observation only; no public CI receipt exists before publication and no result is promoted to Observed or Reproduced here.
The dependency closure is locked, but native compiler, libclang and protoc binaries are not bit-reproducibly pinned by this record.
No binary-to-source provenance claim or deterministic binary identity is made.
counterevidence: An exact Rust 1.80.0 attempt failed closed before compilation because RocksDB 0.24.0 and librocksdb-sys 0.17.3+10.4.2 require Rust 1.85.0; the contract and CI were raised to the dependency-enforced minimum before the passing run.

The first Boost 1.90 follow-up build exposed three removed Boost.Filesystem APIs across the database and wallet paths; the replacements were then compiled through the wallet library and a wallet-enabled bitcoind binary.
A UPnP-enabled macOS build separately exposed MiniUPnPc 2.3.3 API drift. UPnP was disabled for the scoped Boost proof; no MiniUPnP compatibility change is included in this lot.
No node-linked ALP query, mempool index, websocket, HTTP or gRPC behavior exists in this lot.
Any workspace-member expansion, activation of an excluded runtime crate, node link edge, dependency-lock drift, donor-byte drift or unreviewed path must fail the lot boundary.
